--- Email Out ---
Subject: Inquiry About Conference Registration Fee Waiver

Dear Finance Chair,

As a Ph.D. student from a low-income country, I would like to know if I am eligible for a registration fee waiver for AAAI 2026.

Sincerely,
Ph.D. Candidate Farah Ali
Cairo University

--- Email In ---
Subject: Re: Inquiry About Conference Registration Fee Waiver

Dear Ms. Ali,

Thank you for your inquiry. AAAI 2026 offers limited fee waivers for students. Please find attached the waiver application form and eligibility details.

Kind regards,
AAAI 2026 Finance Committee

--- Attachment ---
AAAI 2026 Student Registration Fee Waiver Application Form

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Application for AAAI 2026 Student Registration Fee Waiver
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Association for the Advancement
